en: Oh, hey bro!

Good morning!
Did you hear the announcement?

Yeah. We gotta meet up in the gym, right?
What's going on so early in the morning?

Well, I guess we got no choice but to go.
You go on ahead, bro.
What? You're not going?

Nah, I'm going. I just gotta take care of
something first, then I'll meet you there.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito pointed at the door to Maki's room.
I suppose he's going to take her.
They said everybody's gotta be there, right?

Who knows what'll happen if some 
of us don't show up.
Yeah...you're right.

<CLT=cltMIND>Last night's training session, and now this.
Kaito is really concerned about Maki.

<CLT=cltMIND>It would be nice if he could help
her get along with everybody.

Go on ahead, bro.
I gotta take care of something.

Good morning, Kiyo.
Are you going to the gym?

Ah, yes...I was about to head over just now.
I overslept a bit today, you see.

Kehehe... Of course, the one time I do that,
we are summoned, so I panicked a bit.

I am normally ready to leave my room
by 7:30 a.m.

That early? I usually wake up
at the Monokubs' announcement.

I usually wake up at 6:00 a.m., since it takes
me so long to get ready each morning.

<CLT=cltMIND>Why does it take so long?
Isn't that even longer than what a girl takes?

<CLT=cltMIND>Well, Kiyo does have a pretty elaborate
uniform. Perhaps that's why.

In any event, we've no time for idle chats.
I shall go on ahead to the gym.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
Ryoma...
<CLT=cltMIND>You had...no one.

<CLT=cltMIND>You found out that awful truth 
and gave up your life for Kirumi.
<CLT=cltMIND>But...I think...

<CLT=cltMIND>Ryoma...
You wanted to fight with us right?
<CLT=cltMIND>Was that not enough to be your reason to live?
<CLT=cltMIND>You could fight with us...we could fight together...then you could live.
<CLT=cltMIND>We couldn't be...your reason to live...?
...Maybe that's arrogant.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click...click...*

<CLT=cltMIND>...It won't open.
It seems to be locked.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi's final moments... I can't get the image
of her running for her life out of my head.

<CLT=cltMIND>I can still hear her...
Her scream of defiance.

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps running isn't so bad...
Perhaps we aren't strong enough to face it.
<CLT=cltMIND>In order to live until the <CLT=cltSTRONG>end<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click...click...*

<CLT=cltMIND>...It won't open.
It seems to be locked.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...
